notes.title: MILESTONE REACHED ($29.99 -> $26.99) | An update on our social experiment!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey friends,  [/b][/p][p]How's it going? 
Here's a little update on our social experiment: 
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2719740/view/524227425953908791"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]We're making good progress - our initial milestones however might've been a little bit too optimistic, so we lowered the numbers.

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779790/da73b36ff3b7b5ec1c32d20ebd32dc318da86c24.png"][/img][/h3][p]And with that, [b]we've already reached our 1st milestone[/b], so our launch price dropped to $26.99!
Can we go even lower? 35K would be a dream come true![/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Here’s how you can contribute:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Wishlist Zero Caliber 2 Remastered[/b] on Steam ([i]step 1[/i]):

[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p]
 If you've already wishlisted the game, don't forget to drop in here to enter our giveaway as well: 
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2719740/view/524226158154219957"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]BIG thanks for helping us push through the Steam algorithm and keep the co-op VR shooter genre alive!  [/p][p]Cheers, 
[i]Dan + the XREAL Games Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: This isn't a lazy port | ZERO CALIBER 2 Remastered drops soon!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Zero Cal 2's release is approaching fast, and some of the most frequent questions we’ve been getting are:
[b]“[i]How different is Zero Caliber 2 on Steam compared to standalone?[/i]”[/b][/p][p]and[/p][p][b]“[i]Why did you add ‘Remastered’ to the title?[/i]”[/b][/p][p]and [/p][p][b]“[i]When is it coming?[/i]”[/b][/p][p]
Excellent questions, let’s break it all down.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]“Why did you add ‘Remastered’ to the title?”[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Zero Caliber 2 on PCVR isn’t just a lazy port with higher res textures and better resolution. 
[/b]We pushed things as far as we could within the engine’s limits - and then some. We also added brand new features.  
A few things that got the PCVR treatment:[/p][list][*][p]💥 [b]Visual fidelity got a massive upgrade[/b] - explosions, muzzle flashes, lighting, shadows, textures, VFX… it all hits much harder now.[/p][/*][*][p]🪖 [b]Enemy numbers almost doubled[/b], and AI behavior has been drastically improved to actually challenge you - even in Co-op.[/p][/*][*][p]👨🏻‍🔬 [b]Physics upgrade[/b] - ragdolls are in full swing, enemies react to bullets much more realistically.[/p][/*][*][p]🚀 [b]Several missions have been completely reworked[/b], and pretty much all missions were touched up to deliver a more cinematic experience than you’ve ever seen in a VR shooter.[/p][/*][*][p]💅 [b]Player customization[/b] - you can customize your character with both brand-new gear and throwbacks from the original Zero Caliber.[/p][/*][*][p]🔫 [b]Weapon models got a facelift[/b] to match the upgraded visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ [b]We focused heavily on QoL and tech stability[/b] — aiming for the smoothest, bug-free experience right at launch.[/p][/*][/list][p]… and there’s a [b]lot more[/b] we’re keeping under wraps for now.

Calling it just [i]“Zero Caliber 2”[/i] didn’t feel right - the work that’s gone into this version 100% deserves the [i]Remastered[/i] tag.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]"How different is Zero Caliber 2 on Steam compared to standalone?"[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Why don't you see it for yourself? Check out these side-by-side comparisons ([i]captured in a WiP build[/i]) from our creator friends:[/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@MacInVR" style="button"]Mac in VR[/url][/p][previewyoutube="JoniahRa-r8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@dridvr" style="button"]DriDVR[/url][/p][previewyoutube="nNCGIdrZkuI;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]“When is it coming?”[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re currently running a [b]Closed Beta[/b], and are testing a few bonus features and new weapons we might add for release internally.
We were originally aiming for a [b]September launch[/b], and so far it looks like we’re still on track - keep an eye out for the official release date announcement in the coming weeks![/p][p][b]I promise it’ll be worth the wait.[/b][/p][p][b]... [/b]AND if you’re into what you’re seeing, a [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719740/Zero_Caliber_2_Remastered/"]wishlist on Steam[/url][/b] goes a long way. ❤️ 
Let’s keep the VR shooter genre alive, together! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779790/29d673d645674671b42907077569385bec3698ea.png"][/img][i]Cheers, 
Dan + the XREAL Games team[/i][/p]
